The Medicaid Crisis Planning Checklist

What to summarize, gather and ask now that Mom needs long-term care.

Download PDF

Mom needs long-term care now, and you're handling care decisions, money questions and paperwork in the same week. Before anyone builds a plan, these are the things to have in hand. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is something still to pull together or ask, not a verdict on Mom or on your family.

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you summarize, gather and ask. It doesn't say what comes first, what any item means for Medicaid, or what your family should decide. Those belong to the planning conversation, with a professional who knows your state's rules. Nothing here is legal, financial or tax advice.

Ready for the next step?
